scope: Every sentence in Sections IV-X that reports a numerical result (percentages, times, rates, counts with units, or decimal values).
method: Numbers in comparison records were checked earlier against the PDFs (data/within-study-comparisons.json). For the other sentences, every number was searched in the review card and in the local full-text transcription, and the numbers of each sentence were required to occur together in one transcription passage. Numbers taken from the 2026-11-04 coverage additions (K01-K16) and the numbers added in round 4 (E47) were also re-read on the physical PDF page named in card_locator. Sample statistics come from generated/stats.tex and are asserted in scripts/build_data.py. Source excerpts remain local.
